status: exact global-AdS normal-mode witness; not a Minkowski particle mass or Yang-Mills mass gap

ads4.interpretation: nonzero lowest global energy follows from curvature, reflecting boundary conditions and the compact spatial slicing; it does not break gauge invariance or create a local Fierz-Pauli mass

flatLimit.decision: the lowest global energy is not uniform in the flat ell-to-infinity limit

gapFirewall.notYangMillsGap: the Yang-Mills problem requires a dynamically generated gauge-invariant continuum spectral gap on R4, whereas this scale is imposed by ell and global boundary conditions
gapFirewall.notGravitonMass: the massless AdS representation retains gauge symmetry and two helicities despite E0=3/ell
gapFirewall.notAuxiliaryGap: it supplies no positive mass for torsion, selector or other non-Einstein fields
gapFirewall.observableBoundary: a claimed physical use must specify the AdS patch, boundary conditions and whether the ell-to-infinity limit is required

decision: Spin(2,3) naturally supplies a curvature scale and global AdS level spacing, but this is a seventh gap type and cannot be used as the four-dimensional Yang-Mills gap, a graviton mass, or evidence for gapped extra connection modes.
